note: dcr-check allow-list (T07; brief 2.7). Each exception names a finding kind, the file and the exact codes, with the reason it is accepted for now. scripts/dcr-check.mjs fails on any error not listed here, and on any listed code that no longer produces its finding (a stale entry would hide a regression). Re-check every entry whenever dcr.lock moves, then set dcr_revision. Never change product data to pass. On Rev23 nothing needs an exception: the catalogue takes its titles from the DCR (Hseq-Dev #42) and title differences fail.

excluded_paths.why: Tests. Their fixtures deliberately use sample, unknown and retired codes, so a hit there is the test working, not drift.
Unit tests beside the code (lib/*.test.js); same reason as test/.
